If the Master, casts His Merciful Glance the mortal then sins in the lap of the Meritorious One.
9MJC: O Nanak, this Union cannot be broken; the true profit is obtained. ||8||1||17||
The union, O Nanak breaks not and he earns the true profit.

WPCZ: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand, and then, the account is settled.
If man understands the Lord, by Guru's favour then his account is settled.
QKM7: In each and every heart is the Name of the Immaculate Lord; He is my Lord and Master. ||1||
He whose Name is the Pure One and who is contained in every heart is my Master.
VCWF: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, no one is emancipated. See this, and reflect upon it.
Without Guru's instruction one is not emancipated. See and reflect upon this.
CL3U: Even though you may perform hundreds of thousands of rituals, without the Guru, there is only darkness. ||1||Pause||
Though man may perform lacs of rituals yet without the Guru there is all darkness. Pause
BNQP: What can you say, to one who is blind and without wisdom?
What should we say to those who are blind and devoid of wisdom?
QXUM: Without the Guru, the Path cannot be seen. How can anyone proceed? ||2||
Without the Guru the way cannot be seen. How is then one to get along?
TB1Q: He calls the counterfeit genuine, and does not know the value of the genuine.
To the counterfeit one calls the genuine and the worth of genuine he knows not.
MLH4: The blind man is known as an appraiser; this Dark Age of Kali Yuga is so strange! ||3||
The blind man goes by the name of an assayer. Strange is this Dark-age.
70R7: The sleeper is said to be awake, and those who are awake are like sleepers.
The one who is slept he calls awake and one who is awake he says asleep.
PF8U: The living are said to be dead, and no one mourns for those who have died. ||4||
The living one he says dead, and he weeps not for those who are really dead.
XRMT: One who is coming is said to be going, and one who is gone is said to have come.
He who is coming he says is going and one who is gone he says to have come.
J9NN: That which belongs to others, he calls his own, but he has no liking for that which is his. ||5||
Man calls another's property has own and his own he likes not.
V7C5: That which is sweet is said to be bitter, and the bitter is said to be sweet.
What is sweet, he calls bitter and the bitter he calls sweet.
11T6: One who is imbued with the Lord's Love is slandered - this is what I have seen in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||6||
One imbued with Lord's Love, he slanders. Such is what I have seen in the Dark-age.
9YDW: He serves the maid, and does not see his Lord and Master.
Man serves the hand-maiden but the Master he sees not.
6B3L: Churning the water in the pond, no butter is produced. ||7||
By churning the pool water, no butter comes out.
T0RW: One who understands the meaning of this verse is my Guru.
He who understands the meaning of this stale is my teacher.
1MCJ: O Nanak, one who knows his own self, is infinite and incomparable. ||8||
O Nanak he who knows his own self is infinite and unrivalled.
5MLP: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself misleads the people.
By Himself, the Lord pervades ever-where and Himself He strays the mortals.
THS8: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand, that God is contained in all. ||9||2||18||
Through Guru's grace, man understands this that the Lord is contained among all.
DDAY: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:
5PDP: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God by the grace of the True Guru He is known.
YLVZ: The pollution of the mind is the love of duality.
Duality is the contamination of mind.
2P36: Deluded by doubt, people come and go in reincarnation. ||1||
Infatuated by doubt man comes and goes.
4FXN: The pollution of the self-willed manmukhs will never go away,
Of the perverse person, defilement never departs,
DHCM: as long as they do not dwell on the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
So long as, under Guru's instruction he is not immersed in the Name of God. Pause.
RPS5: All the created beings are contaminated by emotional attachment;
The attachment of all the visible objects is all impurity.
CYBK: they die and are reborn, only to die over and over again. ||2||
Due to this the mortal dies and is reborn again and again.
ELVZ: Fire, air and water are polluted.
Impurity is in fire, air and water.
DU1C: The food which is eaten is polluted. ||3||
Within all the food, which we eat, there is pollution.
D31W: The actions of those who do not worship the Lord are polluted.
Defilement is in man's actions as he performs not Lord's worship.
GZKG: Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind becomes immaculate. ||4||
Imbued with God's Name, the soul is rendered pure.
WAMN: Serving the True Guru, pollution is eradicated,
By serving the True Guru the defilement goes,
1JH8: and then, one does not suffer death and rebirth, or get devoured by death. ||5||
thereby man dies not nor is he reborn nor dies death devour him.
BWX4: You may study and examine the Shaastras and the Simritees,
Let some one see and study the Shashtras and Simirtis.
ERTV: but without the Name, no one is liberated. ||6||
Without the Name none is emancipated.
CFNW: Throughout the four ages, the Naam is the ultimate; reflect upon the Word of the Shabad.
In the four ages, the excellent thing is the Name and the meditation of the Word.
BXRN: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only the Gurmukhs cross over. ||7||
In the Dark-age only the Guru-ward is saved.
RZ1H: The True Lord does not die; He does not come or go.
The True Lord dies not. He comes and goes not.
52FE: O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains absorbed in the Lord. ||8||1||
Nanak, by Guru's grace the mortal remains absorbed in the Name.
ELHH: Selfless service is the support of the breath of life of the Gurmukh.
Lord's service is the prop of Guru-ward's life.
NTTN: Keep the Dear Lord enshrined in your heart.
The Venerable Lord, keep clasped to your mind and soul.
70XP: The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||
Through the Guru, honour is obtained in the True Court.
74CA: O Pandit, O religious scholar, read about the Lord, and renounce your corrupt ways.
O Scholar, read you the Name of God, and eschew vice.
HEZJ: The Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
Through the Guru, cross you the dreadful world-ocean. Pause.

7MG5: The Gurmukh eradicates egotism from within.
Through the Guru ego goes from within.
VQYF: No filth sticks to the Gurmukh.
Through the Guru, filth attaches not the mind.
CMGH: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind of the Gurmukh. ||2||
Through the Guru the Name comes and abides within the mind.
0BPV: Through karma and Dharma, good actions and righteous faith, the Gurmukh becomes true.
By Guru's grace, truth becomes man's actions and religion.
WWRK: The Gurmukh burns away egotism and duality.
By Guru's grace the mortal burns egotism and duality.
FHXD: The Gurmukh is attuned to the Naam, and is at peace. ||3||
By Guru's grace one is imbued with the name and peace is obtained.
7R3T: Instruct your own mind, and understand Him.
Instruct your mind and understand that Lord.
M170: You may preach to other people, but no one will listen.
Otherwise, however much, you mayest preach to the people none would hear you.
5HVS: The Gurmukh understands, and is always at peace. ||4||
By Guru's grace obtain Lord's comprehension and you shall be ever, at peace.
1F4H: The self-willed manmukhs are such clever hypocrites.
An apostate is over-hypocritical and clever.
ADFB: No matter what they do, it is not acceptable.
Whatever he does that becomes not acceptable.
601Q: They come and go in reincarnation, and find no place of rest. ||5||
He comes and goes, and finds no place of rest.
TLMY: The manmukhs perform their rituals, but they are totally selfish and conceited.
The way-ward performs rituals in great pride.
CN5T: They sit there, like storks, pretending to meditate.
Like the heron the, ever, sits in trance.
LHL3: Caught by the Messenger of Death, they shall regret and repent in the end. ||6||
When caught by the Death's myrmidon, he does regret then.
TCU5: Without serving the True Guru, liberation is not obtained.
Sans serving the True Guru, salvation is not attained.
CP1U: By Guru's Grace, one meets the Lord.
By Guru's favour, He, the Lord is met.
K7B2: The Guru is the Great Giver, throughout the four ages. ||7||
The Guru is the Giver, through the Four Ages.
PK9U: For the Gurmukh, the Naam is social status, honor and glorious greatness.
God's Name is the caste, honour and glory of the True Sikhs if the Guru.
AGB6: Maya, the daughter of the ocean, has been slain.
Mammon the daughter of Ocean they have beaten to death.
ZQZ8: O Nanak, without the Name, all clever tricks are false. ||8||2||
Nanak without the Name, false is all cleverness.
KV8B: Learn the Dharma of this age, O Siblings of Destiny;
Repeat you, O brethren the religion of this age (God's Name)
E75X: all understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru.
The Perfect Guru, has imparted to me all the understanding.
MWC7: Here and hereafter, the Lord's Name is our Companion. ||1||
Here and hereafter God's Name is the mortal's succour.
Z2Y1: Learn of the Lord, and contemplate Him in your mind.
Repeat you the Lord Name and reflect thereon within your mind.
9KJA: By Guru's Grace, your filth shall be washed away. ||1||Pause||
By Guru's favour wash off your filth. Pause.
WVYQ: Through argument and debate, He cannot be found.
Through controversies and contentions the Lord in not procured.
6GQM: The mind and body are made insipid through the love of duality.
Through another's love, the soul and body are rendered insipid.
52V8: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, lovingly attune yourself to the True Lord. ||2||
Through Guru's teaching enshrine affection for the True Lord.
GBTG: This world is polluted with egotism.
This World is gone filthy with ego.
W767: By taking cleansing baths daily at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, egotism is not eliminated.
By daily bathing in holy waters egotism goes not.
XXQH: Without meeting the Guru, they are tortured by Death. ||3||
Without meeting the Guru death distresses the man.
9A3L: Those humble beings are true, who conquer their ego.
True is the man, who effaces his ego,
F385: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they conquer the five thieves.
and by Guru's teaching slays the five demons.
TAJ1: They save themselves, and save all their generations as well. ||4||
He saves himself and saves all his generations.
R91D: The Actor has staged the drama of emotional attachment to Maya.
The Actor has set up attachment of mammon as a play for the mortals.
NUKQ: The self-willed manmukhs cling blindly to it.
The blind apostates remain clinging to it.
HCY6: The Gurmukhs remain detached, and lovingly attune themselves to the Lord. ||5||
The Guru-wards remain detached and embrace affection for God.
2PWA: The disguisers put on their various disguises.
The disguiser puts on various garbs.
CED8: Desire rages within them, and they carry on egotistically.
Within him is desire and he walks about proudly.
S8CH: They do not understand themselves, and they lose the game of life. ||6||
His ownself he understands not and loses the game.
U2GU: Putting on religious robes, they act so clever,
Putting on religious garbs some play clever.
FKXQ: but they are totally deluded by doubt and emotional attachment to Maya.
Love of mammon and doubt have supremely misled them.
WSMB: Without serving the Guru, they suffer in terrible pain. ||7||
Without serving the Guru, they suffer immense pain.
D252: Those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, remain detached forever.
They, who are imbued with God's Name, ever, remain detached.
GQG4: Even as householders, they lovingly attune themselves to the True Lord.
Though householders they in their mind enshrine affection for the True Lord.
9R02: O Nanak, those who serve the True Guru are blessed and very fortunate. ||8||3||
Nanak, very fortunate are they who serve the True Guru.
89GR: Brahma is the founder of the study of the Vedas.
Brahma is the founder of the study of Vedas.
E7XB: From him emanated the gods, enticed by desire.
From him emanated the gods, infested with worldly love and desire.
WNB3: They wander in the three qualities, and they do not dwell within their own home. ||1||
They wander in three qualities and abide not in their own home.
UDBF: The Lord has saved me; I have met the True Guru.
Causing me to meet the True Guru the Lord has saved me.
ZC1X: He has implanted devotional worship of the Lord's Name, night and day. ||1||Pause||
Night and day's devotional service and God's Name the Guru has implanted within me. Pause.
84XC: The songs of Brahma entangle people in the three qualities.
The compilations of Brahma involve men in the noose of three dispositions.
2U4Z: Reading about the debates and disputes, they are hit over the head by the Messenger of Death.
There in they read the eventful poems and the courier of Death strikes them on their head.
